title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot. Notice how the number of colonies decreases as the amount of antibiotic increases. This suggests a non-linear relationship.

title: Considering Transformations
text: To linearize a non-linear relationship, consider transformations like logarithmic, square root, or reciprocal transformations.

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: A logarithmic transformation can help linearize relationships where one variable grows exponentially compared to another.

title: Reciprocal Transformation
text: A reciprocal transformation $$\frac{1}{X}$$ can be useful when the relationship is hyperbolic, as it can help straighten the curve.
